title: Building a Reliable Blockchain Indexer with Node.js
excerpt: Worker queues, idempotent ingestion, and PostgreSQL schema design for RPC indexing. Notes from shipping 10,000+ indexed blocks in production.
body:
## Idempotent ingestion

Every block write must be safe to retry. Use unique constraints on block height and tx hash.

## Queues

Decouple RPC pull from DB write. Backpressure beats crashed workers.

## Observability

Track lag vs chain tip. Alert when lag grows, not only when the process dies.
